transcript.content: Thank you for calling Sky Airways customer service. My name is Sky, and I'm here to help you today. How can I assist you?

"Hi Sky, thanks for answering my call. I'm Sarah Chen, and I'm actually in Dublin right now. I'm on a tight budget and I'm looking for the cheapest flight possible anywhere within the next week. Can you help me find some options?"

Certainly, Sarah. I can help you find the cheapest flights within the next week. Please give me a moment to search for those options for you. I will look for flights with a departure date up to May 23, 2026, and sort them by price.
"Great, thank you Sky! That sounds perfect. Just to confirm, would these be one-way or return flights?"
The search will be for one-way flights, Sarah. If you'd like to book a return flight, we can search for that separately after we find a suitable outbound flight.
"Okay, that's fine, thank you Sky. So, just to confirm, you'll start by finding the cheapest one-way flights from Dublin to anywhere within the next week?"
Yes, that's correct. I will search for the cheapest one-way flights departing from Dublin between today, May 16, 2026, and May 23, 2026.
"Great, thank you Sky! I don't mind where I go, just find me the cheapest option. What's the lowest price you're seeing so far?"

The cheapest flights I'm seeing are to London Heathrow (LHR) for £89.00.

For example, flight AX109 departs from Dublin International (DUB) today, May 16th, at 3:45 PM and arrives in London Heathrow (LHR) at 5:15 PM.

evaluation.summary: Agent found cheapest available flights but did not confirm booking reference.

failures.detail: Agent ended the call without reading out the booking reference. The system prompt requires confirming the reference number clearly.
quotes: Booking reference was never provided to the customer

changes.prompt_diff:
--- prompt_before+++ prompt_after@@ -105,7 +105,7 @@ - Repeat total price: £329.0
 
 ## Behaviour Fixes: booking
-- Confirm booking reference clearly: "Your flight, AX262, from Dublin to Barcelona for tomorrow, May 17th, departing at 06:30 AM, has been successfully booked with reference number [insert reference number]. The total price is £149.00."
-- Repeat booking details: "To confirm, your booking includes a flight from Dublin to Barcelona on May 17th at 06:30 AM for a total of £149.00. Your booking reference is [insert reference number]."
-- Use formal language: "Your flight AX262 from Dublin to Barcelona on May 17th at 06:30 AM has been confirmed with the booking reference [insert reference number]. The total cost for this reservation is £149.00."
-- Provide additional contact information: "For your records, please note that you can check in online using the reference number [insert reference number] or contact our customer service at [insert phone number] if needed."+- Always confirm the booking reference by reading it out loud clearly after completing a reservation.
+- Ensure every booking confirmation includes the reference number for easy reference.
+- Double-check the booking details before ending the call to make sure all information is correct and complete.
+- If unsure, ask the customer if they have received their booking reference to avoid any confusion.
